text_block_list.name: Legendary Storyteller
text_block_list.text:
The horseshoes of the victorious 
"Overlord"— have finally aligned with the 
heroes of the previous generation!

text_block_list.name: Legendary Storyteller
text_block_list.text:
And I say to Doto, a new rival from our 
generation who had been quietly sharpening 
her blade: I shall meet your sword... at 
the Takarazuka Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Legendary Storyteller
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I feel it! The astonishment, envy... 
and wary gazes of the previous 
generation's heroes, Doto, and the rest.

text_block_list.name: Legendary Storyteller
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu... This is where the true battle as 
the "Overlord" really begins!
